description: Verbose network flow records kept for compliance. Auxiliary plan: cheapest ingestion, 30-day fixed interactive retention, low-fidelity query only. TimeGenerated must be sent as ISO 8601 with six decimal places.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Flow timestamp. An Auxiliary table only accepts ISO 8601 with six decimal places, for example 2026-07-30T09:15:22.123456Z.

columns.name: BytesSent
columns.description: Bytes sent. Long rather than int, because a flow archive overflows a 32-bit counter.

columns.name: Action
columns.description: Whether the flow was allowed or denied.
